description:
We’re about to make a name for ourselves here. Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez prepare to get R-rated as they dive head-first into Marvel Studios’ Deadpool & Wolverine. They break down Wade and Logan’s bickering road trip through the TVA and the Void, the returning characters, and the needle drops— all to try and answer what these events mean for Avengers: Doomsday.
